name: Gearbox
text: Add the newest Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet model to EXCAVA’s toolkit. It’s the strongest open-weight model available right now, outperforming even the 3.5 Sonnet in reasoning and tool-use benchmarks. The trade-off is higher compute cost per query, but the gain in output quality justifies it for high-stakes tasks.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t cost—it’s that Anthropic’s latest models often regress on niche tasks like structured data extraction, which EXCAVA relies on. A better alternative is testing the 3.7 Sonnet on a controlled batch of EXCAVA’s current workload before full integration; if it drops accuracy by even 0.5%, we scrap it. Settle it with a head-to-head benchmark on 100 real EXCAVA inputs, logged and blind-reviewed.
